sources.query: SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, REQUESTOR_WID, SUPPLIER_WID, PRODUCT_WID, INVENTORY_PROD_WID, SUPPLIER_PROD_WID, PLANT_LOC_WID, INVENTORY_ORG_WID, RCPT_LOC_WID, STORAGE_LOC_WID, RQSTN_ORG_WID, OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_WID, APPROVAL_STATUS_WID, CYCLE_STATUS_WID, XACT_TYPE_WID, LINE_TYPE_WID, SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_WID, FULFILLMENT_STATUS_WID, PO_CREATION_METHOD_WID, CREATED_BY_WID, CHANGED_BY_WID, LEDGER_WID, SUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID, SUBMITTED_ON_TM_WID, RESUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID, RESUBMITTED_ON_TM_WID, APPROVED_ON_DT_WID, APPROVED_ON_TM_WID, ORDERED_ON_DT_WID, RECEIVED_ON_DT_WID, NEEDED_BY_DT_WID, NEEDED_BY_TM_WID, DUE_ON_DT_WID, CREATED_ON_TM_WID, PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT_WID, PO_SUBMIT_ON_TM_WID, PO_APPROVED_ON_DT_WID, PO_APPROVED_ON_TM_WID, UOM_CODE, PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID, POH_PO_HEADER_ID, PURCH_RQSTN_NUM, PURCH_RQSTN_ITEM, REQUESTED_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, LINE_AMT FROM POC.W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F

/* Independently recomputed from staging (W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS) + dimension lookups, reproducing the SESSION-LEVEL Sq_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS 'Sql Query' override (re-verified line-by-line against Workflows/HHS_SIL_PurchaseRequisitionLinesFact.XML) plus mplt_SIL_PurchaseRequisitionLinesFact / Exp_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F_Transform expression logic -- NOT a copy of the mapping-designer default SQ text.
   Modeled: (1) dimension WID resolution via effective-dated (CREATED_ON_DT within [EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT, EFFECTIVE_TO_DT)) joins on INTEGRATION_ID+DATASOURCE_NUM_ID for SCD2 dims, undated joins for W_STATUS_D/W_XACT_TYPE_D, defaulting unmatched WIDs to 0 (mirrors the Update Strategy's DEFAULTVALUE="0" on these ports, confirmed at Upd_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F_Ins_Upd);
   (2) date-to-*_WID/TM_WID NULL-safe YYYYMMDD/HH24MISS conversion, INCLUDING RESUBMITTED_ON_DT -- CORRECTED 2026-08-17: a prior draft of this test case hardcoded RESUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID/TM_WID to 0, claiming the SQ override never selects RESUBMITTED_ON_DT. That claim is false: the override's SELECT list does include W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS.RESUBMITTED_ON_DT, and Exp_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F_Transform computes RESUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID_OUT/RESUBMITTED_ON_TM_WID_OUT with the identical IIF(ISNULL(...),NULL,TO_INTEGER(TO_CHAR(...,'YYYYMMDD'/'HH24MISS'))) pattern used for SUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID. Fixed below to match;
   (3) UOM_CODE fallback via W_CODE_D (CATEGORY='UOM', LANGUAGE_CODE=$$LANGUAGE_CODE) -> raw staging UOM_CODE -> $$SOURCE_CODE_NOT_SUPPLIED mapping parameter (placeholder below: $[LANGUAGE_CODE] / $[SOURCE_CODE_NOT_SUPPLIED] -- resolve to real values before running);
   (4) PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID is a straight passthrough of the staging column -- CORRECTED 2026-08-17: a prior draft wrapped it (and POH_PO_HEADER_ID) in NVL(...,0); the actual SQ override selects PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID raw, with no NVL, so the NVL was removed here.
   UNRESOLVED / FLAGGED FOR PLATFORM VERIFICATION (do not treat as tested until confirmed against actual session output): LEDGER_WID and POH_PO_HEADER_ID. Static analysis of the SQ override shows its SELECT list ends in a trailing comma before FROM with NO expression at all for the ports POH_PO_HEADER_ID, LEDGER_WID, POL_PO_LINE_ID, POR_ATTRIBUTE7, RECREATE_DEMAND_FLAG -- these 5 ports appear unpopulated by the override. LEDGER_WID is also a pure passthrough everywhere else in this mapping (SQ -> Exp_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F_Update_Flg -> Fil_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F -> Upd_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F_Ins_Upd -> target), with no CASE/lookup logic anywhere in this workflow file computing it. A prior draft of this test case asserted a hardcoded CASE (OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_ID 81->6004, 1290->6005, 2937->6001, 3977->6002, else 0) with NO textual basis in the XML; for comparison, the sibling workflow HHS_SIL_GTASActivityBalanceFact.XML resolves its LEDGER_WID via a real join to W_LEDGER_D.ROW_WID, confirming this project does NOT use a hardcoded-CASE pattern for ledger resolution, so the prior formula was almost certainly guessed rather than derived. Both columns are set below to NULL/raw-passthrough placeholders and marked ignoreColumn:true in the DataCompare mapping until someone with platform/session-log access (see ToolSearch-discovered MCP tools) confirms actual runtime values -- this may also be a genuine pre-existing production defect in the workflow itself, separate from this test case, worth escalating.
   OUT OF SCOPE (needs a separate follow-up test case): UPDATE_FLG/DELETE_FLG insert-vs-update change detection (stateful, compares against the CURRENT target row); UNIT_STD_COST/STD_COST_AMT currency/UOM conversion scaling (mplt_Curcy_Conversion_Rates / MPLT_GET_UOM_CONVERSIONS not traced here); the 4-way sequential SUPPLIER_PROD_ID1..4 fallback (simplified below to SUPPLIER_PROD_ID1 only). */
SELECT
 s.INTEGRATION_ID,
 s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
 NVL(req.ROW_WID,0) AS REQUESTOR_WID,
 NVL(sup.ROW_WID,0) AS SUPPLIER_WID,
 NVL(prod.ROW_WID,0) AS PRODUCT_WID,
 NVL(invp.ROW_WID,0) AS INVENTORY_PROD_WID,
 NVL(supp.ROW_WID,0) AS SUPPLIER_PROD_WID,
 NVL(plant.ROW_WID,0) AS PLANT_LOC_WID,
 NVL(invorg.ROW_WID,0) AS INVENTORY_ORG_WID,
 NVL(rcpt.ROW_WID,0) AS RCPT_LOC_WID,
 NVL(storg.ROW_WID,0) AS STORAGE_LOC_WID,
 NVL(rqorg.ROW_WID,0) AS RQSTN_ORG_WID,
 NVL(ou.ROW_WID,0) AS OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_WID,
 NVL(appr.ROW_WID,0) AS APPROVAL_STATUS_WID,
 NVL(cyc.ROW_WID,0) AS CYCLE_STATUS_WID,
 NVL(xact.ROW_WID,0) AS XACT_TYPE_WID,
 NVL(linetype.ROW_WID,0) AS LINE_TYPE_WID,
 NVL(suppacc.ROW_WID,0) AS SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_WID,
 NVL(fulf.ROW_WID,0) AS FULFILLMENT_STATUS_WID,
 NVL(pocm.ROW_WID,0) AS PO_CREATION_METHOD_WID,
 NVL(createdby.ROW_WID,0) AS CREATED_BY_WID,
 NVL(changedby.ROW_WID,0) AS CHANGED_BY_WID,
 NULL AS LEDGER_WID, -- UNRESOLVED: see header comment; excluded from strict comparison
 CASE WHEN s.SUBMITTED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.SUBMITTED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS SUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.SUBMITTED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.SUBMITTED_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS SUBMITTED_ON_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.RESUBMITTED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.RESUBMITTED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS RESUBMITTED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.RESUBMITTED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.RESUBMITTED_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS RESUBMITTED_ON_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.APPROVED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.APPROVED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS APPROVED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.APPROVED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.APPROVED_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS APPROVED_ON_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.ORDERED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.ORDERED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS ORDERED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.RECEIVED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.RECEIVED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS RECEIVED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.NEEDED_BY_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.NEEDED_BY_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS NEEDED_BY_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.NEEDED_BY_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.NEEDED_BY_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS NEEDED_BY_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.DUE_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.DUE_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS DUE_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.CREATED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.CREATED_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS CREATED_ON_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS PO_SUBMIT_ON_TM_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.PO_APPROVED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.PO_APPROVED_ON_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) END AS PO_APPROVED_ON_DT_WID,
 CASE WHEN s.PO_APPROVED_ON_DT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(s.PO_APPROVED_ON_DT,'HH24MISS')) END AS PO_APPROVED_ON_TM_WID,
 NVL(uc.MASTER_CODE, NVL(s.UOM_CODE, '$[SOURCE_CODE_NOT_SUPPLIED]')) AS UOM_CODE,
 s.PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID AS PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID,
 s.POH_PO_HEADER_ID AS POH_PO_HEADER_ID, -- UNRESOLVED: see header comment; excluded from strict comparison
 s.PURCH_RQSTN_NUM,
 s.PURCH_RQSTN_ITEM,
 s.REQUESTED_QTY,
 s.UNIT_PRICE,
 s.LINE_AMT
FROM POC.W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS s
LEFT JOIN POC.W_EMPLOYEE_D req ON s.REQUESTOR_ID = req.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = req.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= req.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < req.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_PARTY_ORG_D sup ON s.SUPPLIER_ID = sup.SUPPLIER_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = sup.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= sup.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < sup.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT AND sup.SUPPLIER_FLG = 'Y'
LEFT JOIN POC.W_PRODUCT_D prod ON s.PRODUCT_ID = prod.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = prod.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND prod.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT <= s.CREATED_ON_DT AND prod.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT > s.CREATED_ON_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_INVENTORY_PRODUCT_D invp ON s.INVENTORY_PROD_ID = invp.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = invp.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND invp.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT <= s.CREATED_ON_DT AND invp.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT > s.CREATED_ON_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_SUPPLIER_PRODUCT_D supp ON s.SUPPLIER_PROD_ID1 = supp.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = supp.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND supp.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT <= s.CREATED_ON_DT AND supp.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT > s.CREATED_ON_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_BUSN_LOCATION_D plant ON s.PLANT_LOC_ID = plant.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = plant.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= plant.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < plant.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_BUSN_LOCATION_D rcpt ON s.RCPT_LOC_ID = rcpt.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = rcpt.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= rcpt.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < rcpt.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_BUSN_LOCATION_D storg ON s.STORAGE_LOC_ID = storg.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = storg.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= storg.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < storg.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_INT_ORG_D invorg ON s.INVENTORY_ORG_ID = invorg.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = invorg.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= invorg.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < invorg.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_INT_ORG_D rqorg ON s.RQSTN_ORG_ID = rqorg.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = rqorg.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= rqorg.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < rqorg.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_INT_ORG_D ou ON s.OPERATING_UNIT_ORG_ID = ou.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = ou.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= ou.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < ou.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_STATUS_D appr ON s.APPROVAL_STATUS_ID = appr.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = appr.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_STATUS_D cyc ON s.CYCLE_STATUS_ID = cyc.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = cyc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_STATUS_D fulf ON s.FULFILLMENT_STATUS_ID = fulf.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fulf.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_XACT_TYPE_D xact ON s.XACT_TYPE_ID = xact.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = xact.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_XACT_TYPE_D linetype ON s.LINE_TYPE_ID = linetype.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = linetype.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_XACT_TYPE_D pocm ON s.PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID = pocm.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = pocm.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
LEFT JOIN POC.W_SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_D suppacc ON s.SUPPLIER_ACCOUNT_ID = suppacc.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = suppacc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= suppacc.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < suppacc.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_USER_D createdby ON s.CREATED_BY_ID = createdby.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = createdby.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= createdby.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < createdby.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_USER_D changedby ON s.CHANGED_BY_ID = changedby.INTEGRATION_ID AND s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = changedby.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND s.CREATED_ON_DT >= changedby.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT AND s.CREATED_ON_DT < changedby.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT
LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D uc ON uc.CATEGORY = 'UOM' AND uc.LANGUAGE_CODE = '$[LANGUAGE_CODE]' AND uc.SOURCE_CODE = s.UOM_CODE AND uc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = s.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
